issue: No national LGA-level cricket registration/acquisition outcome.
risk_to_interpretation: Cannot validate whether high scores lead to more cricket registrations.
mitigation: Use CA/PlayHQ new registrations, retention and conversion by geography.

issue: No consistent national club/program/facility capacity dataset.
risk_to_interpretation: Cannot calculate formal System Readiness or final Phase 6 strategic quadrant.
mitigation: Integrate clubs, programs, fields, hours, utilisation, waitlists and volunteer capacity.

issue: Current ABS age/sex data supports 5–14, not exact CA strategic 5–12.
risk_to_interpretation: Junior market is an approximation of the strategic target cohort.
mitigation: Use exact-age internal registration/ABS TableBuilder where feasible; sensitivity-test 5–12 vs 5–14.

issue: South Asian/cultural Census layer not integrated into Model V1.
risk_to_interpretation: Model omits one explicit CA strategic-priority dimension.
mitigation: Add responsibly defined Census/registration measures; keep demographic identity separate from assumed cricket demand.

issue: Inputs span 2021 SEIFA, 2024 age/sex, 2025 population and 2025/26 contextual cricket evidence.
risk_to_interpretation: Scores combine best-available data from different reference years.
mitigation: Retain year metadata; refresh annually; avoid calling the dataset '2026 data'.

issue: East Arnhem/Groote Archipelago restructure creates missing age/SEIFA compatibility; Merri-bek required documented correspondence.
risk_to_interpretation: Some records cannot be compared perfectly through time.
mitigation: Use ABS correspondences and current boundary standards; flag changed areas.

issue: Players can live, attend school and play across council boundaries.
risk_to_interpretation: LGA may not equal true club/program catchment.
mitigation: Use SA2/postcode and drive-time/club-catchment analysis with internal data.

issue: Absolute market size naturally favours large metropolitan LGAs.
risk_to_interpretation: National model may understate small but locally important regional opportunities.
mitigation: Use peer-group/remoteness benchmarking alongside national percentiles.

issue: Percentage growth can be extreme in small populations.
risk_to_interpretation: Growth-rate rankings can overstate tiny markets.
mitigation: Retain minimum-size guardrails and pair rates with absolute change.

issue: Score is relative to eligible LGAs, not an absolute demand scale.
risk_to_interpretation: A score of 95 does not mean 95% demand or 95% probability.
mitigation: Label clearly as relative percentile-based Opportunity Potential.

issue: Weights are normative because no outcome exists to optimise them.
risk_to_interpretation: Balanced model is defensible but not uniquely 'correct'.
mitigation: Retain scenario analysis; calibrate weights only when outcome data exists.

issue: Phase 14 cases were purposively chosen from major growth systems.
risk_to_interpretation: External validation can overrepresent confirming cases.
mitigation: Test lower-ranked and contradictory cases in future validation.

issue: Local facility evidence varies in quality/availability by council/state.
risk_to_interpretation: Qualitative readiness comparisons are not nationally standardised.
mitigation: Create consistent national facility schema and data-sharing process.

issue: Population attributes do not prove willingness to play cricket.
risk_to_interpretation: Risk of overclaiming 'untapped demand', especially for cultural groups.
mitigation: Use direct behaviour/registration evidence and participant research.

issue: Observational geographic model identifies associations only.
risk_to_interpretation: Cannot claim demographic growth causes cricket participation growth.
mitigation: Use experimental/quasi-experimental program evaluation for causal claims.

issue: 2019–2024 youth growth spans COVID-disrupted migration/population periods.
risk_to_interpretation: Some five-year changes may reflect unusual demographic movements.
mitigation: Compare multiple windows when later releases allow.

issue: National ranking excludes some very small/unincorporated records; NT age coverage incomplete.
risk_to_interpretation: Model is not a complete remote-community prioritisation framework.
mitigation: Create separate remote/First Nations/community-specific approach rather than forcing national LGA ranking.
